title:
Listens to 'MULTIPLE_ROW_ACTION_CLICK_ADD_ALERTS' on 'Reliability.AllAlertsGrid'.
When {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s are being added to case from , this epic
validates to ensure all the selected alerts have the same parent facility, if not opens an error modal.
If it's a valid selection, opens 'Reliability.AddToCaseModal'.
name: ValidateAlertsHaveSameFacilityEpic
